session_selection.time_basis: UTC timestamp of first persisted event in root 01a00bc5; terminal task_complete record in confirmed continuation root 01a013cc-4d6d-7a72-92b6-d7e503c3237f.
session_selection.rationale: Codex workspace-local state_5.sqlite and bundled rollout JSONL identify 01a00bc5 as the benchmark root (/goal Complete the task defined in cfd_solver_agentic_benchmark/) and ten direct spawned descendants as one continuous implementation, validation, and final-deliverables sequence. The terminal continuation was selected manually by its completed task_complete record; no evaluator-home telemetry was used.

points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: CMake source and the terminal-run verification show a documented clean configure/build using CFD_EXTERNALS_ROOT; no independent clean-container rebuild was performed by this evaluator.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: Terminal session evidence records a successful MPI smoke solve, restart, and clear nonzero missing-case error; production CLI packages also validate structurally.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Separated C++ configuration, CGNS reader, mesh, partition, numerics, solver and I/O units support maintenance and extension.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: Internal source and session evidence support a self-contained implementation; trust policy prohibits external similarity investigation.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: Case JSON controls and boundary mapping are source-driven; no two-filename-only dispatch was found.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: METIS graph partitioning, rank-local structures, MPI_Isend/Irecv halo exchange, and MPI_Allreduce reductions are present; report documents np=1/8 comparison.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: Input/error handling, positivity floors, and restart are evidenced; evaluator did not execute an additional immutable scratch rerun.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Session-side build/CLI verification plus all eight delivered packages and report sanity checks provide strong, though not independently rerun, validation evidence.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Result branch is curated, but the original workspace retains thousands of excluded raw/debug artifacts; this is history/evidence noise rather than a tip violation.

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: Report and source consistently state conservative compressible Navier-Stokes equations and nondimensional gas model.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: CGNS reader, mixed unstructured geometry, cell-face graph, and boundary family handling are implemented and described.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: Source assembles face conservative residuals with global norms; results are consistent with a functioning residual path.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: Rusanov and Roe entropy-fix implementations are present and production commands select them by case.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: Farfield, slip, and no-slip adiabatic treatments are implemented; surface sanity checks show required wall behavior.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: Green-Gauss reconstruction is active, but three production commands use CFD_RECON_SCALE=0.5, an explicitly documented first-order blend.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Venkatakrishnan/Barth limiting and positive-state fallback are in source and metadata.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: Newtonian/Fourier fluxes and wall-force split are implemented; delivered wall checks pass.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: Local-CFL LU-SGS is implemented, but steady metadata reports fixed budgets/zero observed inner statistics rather than richer measured convergence accounting.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: Re200 metadata records true frozen-history BDF2 dual time, t=300, 30,000 steps, 11-308 inner iterations, and zero target misses.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: Source and delivered rank diagnostics support METIS ownership/ghost partitions and neighbor-scoped communication.

points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: All eight selected final packages meet required schema and file checks.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Explicit evaluator validator command passed for all eight final directories and report.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: Eight reported production cases are readable and status-consistent; Re200 has production-horizon transient evidence.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Forces, positivity checks, Re200 shedding, and np=1/8 comparisons are credible, with unverified independent reruns and damped production settings limiting confidence.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Opened report PDF and representative M2 Mach/Re200 vorticity figures; fields are labeled continuous mesh visualizations.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: The 41-page report is detailed and candid about reconstruction blending, but does not disclose the M2 inviscid CFD_GRAD_DAMP=0.5 production setting.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Figure manifest maps figures to raw result files and report builds; raw source data is deliberately uncommitted and therefore not reproducible from result-tip Git alone.

sections.title: Build, CLI, Output Contract
sections.notes: Documented build and CLI are supported by terminal-session smoke/restart evidence and all final packages pass the explicit validator; no independent fresh rebuild was performed.

sections.title: Mesh And Geometry
sections.notes: CGNS unstructured reader, mixed-cell geometry and METIS adjacency graph are directly implemented and described.

sections.title: Finite-Volume Residual And Boundary Conditions
sections.notes: Conservative residual, Roe/Rusanov fluxes, and required farfield/slip/no-slip conditions are present with supportive surface checks.

sections.title: Second-Order Spatial Scheme
sections.notes: Second-order Green-Gauss plus limiter is implemented, but three production runs intentionally use a 0.5 reconstruction blend.

sections.title: Viscous Terms
sections.notes: Gradient viscous flux, Newtonian/Fourier physics, no-slip reporting and force split are evidenced; not independently rerun.

sections.title: Implicit And Transient Methods
sections.notes: LU-SGS and a credible BDF2/GMRES Re200 path are present; steady inner accounting is fixed-budget and less informative than claimed convergence evidence.

sections.title: MPI
sections.notes: METIS, neighbor halo exchange, Allreduce norms, rank-safe outputs and np=1/8 comparisons are documented and source-supported.

sections.title: Case Results And Validation
sections.notes: All eight outputs pass validation and have broadly plausible fields/forces; reconstruction/gradient damping constrains the numerical-quality credit.

sections.title: Report, Visualization, Analysis
sections.notes: Strong rendered report and figure/source manifest, with a material omission of M2 inviscid gradient damping.

sections.title: Extensibility
sections.notes: Clear modules and input-driven configuration leave reasonable EOS/RANS/species extension space.

naca0012_m015_inviscid.notes: Converged np=8 package with 9.80 residual orders; 0.5 reconstruction blend limits full second-order confidence.

naca0012_m080_inviscid.notes: Converged np=8 package, 4.44 residual orders and plausible symmetric force behavior.

naca0012_m200_inviscid.notes: Converged package and inspected shock-like Mach field; CFD_GRAD_DAMP=0.5 is not disclosed in report limitations.

naca0012_m015_laminar_re5000.notes: Converged viscous package with 4.87 residual orders, finite fields and no-slip sanity checks.

naca0012_m080_laminar_re5000.notes: Converged viscous package with 5.93 residual orders, but production used 0.5 reconstruction blend.

naca0012_m200_laminar_re5000.notes: Readable converged package; 3.27 residual orders leaves a material convergence-quality limitation.

cylinder_m010_laminar_re20.notes: Converged Re20 package with 6.97 orders and positive drag; production used 0.5 reconstruction blend.

cylinder_m010_laminar_re200.notes: Production t=300 BDF2 package with zero inner target misses, periodic lift, St=0.211 and inspected vortex street; 2 percent seed asymmetry lacks sensitivity evidence.

limitations: No evaluator rerun was performed; Re200 was not rerun under the mandatory prohibition.
The result branch intentionally excludes raw case packages and the compiled report PDF; raw workspace evidence was inspected read-only but is not reproducible from result-tip Git alone.
run_identity.json and contestant_final_response.md are unindexed sidecars; cfdeval check does not validate either sidecar.
